style: hand-painted storybook gouache game art, soft painted edges, warm paper texture, thick readable silhouette
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c). Every sprite that takes part in the mechanic declares its orientation in words (rule C.8): the plume, the station post, the back chevron and the two tilt glyphs are asymmetric and say which way they face; everything else is declared symmetric so stage 5c0 never mirrors it. No prompt argues about the background colour of a cut-out subject - the pipeline removes it (rule F.1b). There is no audio asset of any kind (rule C.20). No prompt contains the app name and no sprite carries lettering (hard rule 1): the splash and menu mark is an abstract ring stamp with an egg silhouette inside it. The icon hero is one object, a single cream egg resting in a tilted carry tray.
